column1: # Tier 2 group C-south (Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Slovenia, Croatia, Hungary, Romania, Mexico, Australia). Same columns as t2-countries.tsv; a twelfth column names the profile that decides how the reader writes a line.

# Postcode forms: pl (UPU Poland sheet and Poczta Polska's addressing rules: two digits, a dash, three digits, left of the locality), cz-sk (UPU Czech Republic and Slovakia sheets: three digits, a space, two digits, then two spaces), 4d (Slovenia, Hungary), 5d (Croatia, Mexico), 6d (UPU Romania sheet), au (UPU Australia sheet: locality, state, postcode on the last line).

# Profiles: pl, cz, sk, si, hr, hu (locality line above the street line, postcode on a line of its own: UPU Hungary sheet, Magyar Posta), ro, mx (state abbreviation after the locality, UPU Mexico sheet), au (street and locality lines in capitals without punctuation, Australia Post).
